notes.title: Update 1.3.2 Kofi Annan
notes.content:
[b]General :[/b]
- Added a mod system with these features (I'll create a guide on how to use it): 
	- User can add custom events (there's a small tutorial)
	- User can add custom data and make it evolve. There's currently no guide for this (and it's not trivial) so feel free to ask me how it works, i will answer.
- Added automatic translations for russian, turkish, portuguese, brazilian, spanish, german and italian
- Added in-game bug reports
- Added auto save each X turns
- Added vote date for bills
- Added parliamentary elections history
- Added political parties history for political figures
- Improved job history for political figures
- Fix bug where the player is stuck between two turns
- Fix bug where the player is stuck on the vote window
- Reduced savefile size
- Reduced savefile loading time
- Minor bug fixes

[b]Data:[/b]
- Simplification of population degree levels
- Optimization of job assignement
- Correction of expenditure trends for each ministry
- Minor tweaks to inflation calculation
- Adjustement of industry production calculation to better link it to natural technological evolution
- Introduction of capital and households in consumption calculations
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patchnote 1.2.1
notes.content:
- inbox messages now display the turn it was sent, not a real date so we avoid the sorting problem where new mails with a date inferior to the last mail get placed at the top of the list
- improved localization system so we can add options (like genders) to localized texts
- fix game crashing because of Media being null after loading the game
- fix bug where you could open the menu when turn is passing
- fix localization errors

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 Obama
notes.content:
- Added a system for managing the party, its budget and its members, accessible via a button in the "Political management" window.
- Presidential elections added
- Parliamentary elections added
- Prime Minister position added
- Added a basic system of cohabitation, where it's not possible to appoint a prime minister if the player doesn't have a majority. A prime minister from the player's party increases the chances of a law being passed. A prime minister from the opposite party increases the chances of becoming an ally.
- Added an option to dissolve the assembly, accessible via a button in the "Political management" window.
- Added an option at game creation to choose the election date.
- Added a window to view the results of past presidential elections.
- Addition of tooltips
- Addition of a system of favorite figures and access to favorites via the top bar.
- Addition of a "Job history" page in the figure window.
- Addition of a "Voting history" page in the figure window
- IP ready to spend indicator added
- Correction of UI bugs
- Preparation of a system to modify the number of votes required to pass a law
- Figures can now be sorted by ministry affinity
- Default ministers are of the same party as the player
- Bug fixes

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 Chirac
notes.content:
- Show politician’s political party logo on "job management" page
- Vote result and intentions now shows total number of yes and no votes + abstention
- Can now skip turn / go to the next event using space bar
- Mouse is not bound to the screen anymore, you can change the option in the settings
- Default bill name is now the name of the first law added
- Show total party share of alliance on the page for alliance
- Bill vote history in the politician card
- When the year changes, politicians become older too, and if they are old enough, they can die. When they die they are replaced with a new political figure
- The player can now right click to pin a tooltip and click anywhere else to close it => several nested tooltips can now be open altogether
- The player can now “force vote” a bill (like the 49.3) but we didn’t name it this way as other countries may have that type of “feature”
- Added continue button in main menu
- Inflation going down should be green and not red, and vice versa => should be ok for every value. 
- Show public balance and GDP in the top bar
- Someone suggested this : “I also think maybe good idea to take to political parties page when you click on a party logo” => impossible can cause error but we added the number of seats in the party tooltip
- Reduced overall IP costs
- New law in the ministry of education: you can now choose to teach evolutionary theory or creationism. This affects the number of religious people in the country.
- Temporary patch regarding the huge increase in unemployment over the years. At the same time, it had an impact on the GDP, which was decreasing a lot. The problem is known and identified but requires a major rework of the job search algorithm. We have deployed a minor fix in the meantime, the unemployment rate should not explode as before.
- Correction of the calculation of the data over the year, you should no longer see a "jump" in the data history at the time of a new year.
- Correction of the prison population data which showed a percentage higher than 100% (don't we all live in a prison called Life....)
- Fixed a bug when MP quits politics causing crash
- Fixed a bug where MP has more than 100 efficiency in a ministry
- Fixed some minor bugs
- Fixed some missing translations
